method: Each image generated from scratch from text; no earlier generated image was passed as a reference or edit target.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a COMPLETELY NEW illustration from scratch of Megumin (めぐみん) from the KonoSuba television anime, in her canonical adventurer costume. This is a fresh character-model design pass, NOT an edit, continuation or tracing of any earlier generated illustration. Establish the anatomy and composition anew.

Purpose: a comfortable, natural IDLE base pose for a 2D turn-based game. Full body, eye-level view, entire body facing SCREEN RIGHT in a clear three-quarter orientation around 40 degrees. Her face follows that direction while both red eyes remain readable. A quiet slightly cheeky closed smile, relaxed eyebrows; she is calmly waiting, not performing for a poster.

Build: faithfully petite and slender like the official TV-anime Megumin character model, narrow shoulders, compact torso, youthful compact face, natural limb proportions. Aim for balanced ordinary anime proportions, roughly six to six-and-a-half heads from crown of skull to sole EXCLUDING the hat, judged as a coherent whole rather than making the legs disproportionately long or short. Neither chibi nor a tall fashion model. Head and hands should feel naturally related to her body. Normal knee positions, normal calf lengths, normally sized flat practical boots. Keep the waist at its anatomical position and the dress hem at upper/mid thigh, not artificially pulled down to hide anatomy.

Comfortable standing mechanics: pelvis nearly level and torso upright over the feet, shoulders dropped, neck relaxed. Both soles planted, feet casually separated about hip width, toes point diagonally screen-right, one foot just slightly ahead due to perspective. Knees soft but almost straight. No deep knee bends, locked backwards knees, crossed legs, heels touching, outward squat, conspicuous hip sway, fashion contrapposto or exaggerated arch. It should feel effortless to stand here for several minutes.

Hands: anatomical RIGHT hand loosely but correctly grips a near-vertical wooden staff at about waist/low-rib height. Right upper arm rests close to the ribs, elbow naturally bent, wrist neutral. The staff stands just outside her silhouette, tip resting on the same ground as her boots. The anatomical LEFT arm simply hangs comfortably at her side, soft elbow, naturally half-curled fingers near the thigh, with a small readable separation from the dress. No raised hat-tipping hand, no spread casting fingers. Cape rests quietly under gravity behind her, a gentle fold or two, not blown outward.

Canonical appearance: dark chestnut short bob, slightly uneven bangs and two longer framing locks, crimson eyes. Red long-sleeved adventurer tunic/dress, mustard-gold neckline/cuffs, black X-lacing on chest, broad dark-brown belt with silver rectangular buckle, gold triangular hem pattern. Dark brown cape with golden trim and muted warm lining. Dark choker with silver buckle, fingerless gloves. Her anatomical RIGHT leg has white bandage wrapping, LEFT leg a charcoal thigh-high stocking, orange-brown calf boots with turned golden cuffs. Do not swap left and right. No eye patch.

IMPORTANT HAT DIRECTION from the official side-view model: the broad-brimmed dark-brown wizard hat has ONE soft bent pointed crown drooping BACKWARD behind her head, toward SCREEN LEFT for this right-facing pose, with ONE yellow-orange tassel at that rear tip. The tip does not point forward over her nose. Keep the two red circular gold-cross badges, red/gold zigzag band and thin gold brim edge. Natural right-facing perspective of the brim.
Staff: recognizable forked curved wooden Megumin staff with one red orb, simple wrapped shaft, complete unbroken outline, modestly taller than the hat. Correct natural grip.

Visual style: fresh clean television-anime character art, crisp economical linework, warm muted red and brown palette, simple two-tone cel shading, clear compact facial construction, restrained detail. Not 3D, not photoreal, not glossy gacha illustration, not airbrushed gradients. No artificially enlarged boots or elaborate fashion accessories.

ONE character only. Complete hat, staff top and bottom, cape, fingers and both boots wholly inside portrait canvas with clear margins. TRUE transparent alpha background; no colored haze, scenery, ground drawing, floor shadow, magic effects, typography or watermark.

Generate a NEW full-body Megumin from KonoSuba anime, from scratch, as a clean character model for an idle game animation. Do not edit, trace, continue or use an earlier generated image. Transparent alpha background.

Main priority: balanced, naturally slender anime body proportions. Megumin is petite with narrow shoulders, but she must not look short-legged. Use approximately 6.5-head proportions excluding her wizard hat, with a compact upper torso and normal length legs. Anatomical waist sits at the natural waist, the belt is not dropped onto the low hips. Her red tunic has a short upper-thigh hem; it should not become a long mid-thigh dress or a stretched abdomen. Give thigh and calf enough natural length, comparable to the standard TV anime character, with correctly located knees and modest practical boots. Avoid both tiny-head fashion-model legs and oversized-head short-legged chibi anatomy. The viewer should read a small, slim, well-proportioned mage, not a tall woman or a doll.

Pose: standing comfortably, entire body facing screen-right in a 40-degree three-quarter view. Head, chest, pelvis and feet share this orientation. Calm slightly knowing closed smile and clear crimson eyes, both eyes visible. Torso upright, pelvis almost level, shoulders relaxed. Both feet planted a modest hip-width apart, toes diagonally right, one foot slightly forward only because of the natural stance. Knees soft and almost straight. No squat, crossed legs, stiff locked knees, exaggerated hip sway or dramatic leaning.

Her anatomical right arm hangs comfortably close to her ribs, elbow softly bent; right hand loosely and correctly holds a near-vertical staff at lower-rib/waist height beside her body. Staff bottom rests at boot-sole level, head stays clear of her face. Anatomical left arm hangs easily at her side, hand naturally half-curled near her upper thigh, no splayed fingers. Cape falls quietly behind her rather than billowing.

Recognizable official-anime Megumin design: dark chestnut bob with uneven short bangs and two longer framing locks, compact softly angular face and crimson eyes. Red long-sleeved adventurer tunic, gold neckline and cuffs, black X lacing, broad brown belt with rectangular silver buckle, gold triangular hem border. Dark brown cape with gold edge and muted warm lining. Choker with silver buckle and dark fingerless gloves. White bandages on her anatomical RIGHT leg, charcoal thigh-high stocking on her LEFT leg, orange-brown practical calf boots with turned gold cuffs. Slim ordinary boots, not oversized or tall-shafted.

Wizard hat: dark brown, wide brim, red-and-gold zigzag band, two red round badges bearing gold crosses. Exactly ONE bent crown tip and ONE dangling yellow-orange tassel. Tip droops BACKWARD toward screen-left behind the right-facing head, following the official side-view design, never forward over the nose. Hat should fit the head naturally.
Staff: familiar asymmetrical forked wooden head enclosing one red orb, long straight-ish wooden shaft with wrapped grip. Both head and lower end fully visible, tip grounded. Do not replace with a metal scepter.

Style: crisp economical TV anime linework and restrained two-tone cel shading, warm muted crimson, mustard gold and dark brown. Clear compact character drawing with carefully constructed anatomy. No airbrushed gloss, no 3D, no photorealism. Eye-level camera, no foreshortening tricks. One complete figure only, with margin around the hat, cape, hands, staff and boots. No scenery, glow, haze, floor, floor shadow, magic effects, writing, labels or watermarks.
